title: Nebius Group N.V. unaudited condensed consolidated financial statements for the quarter ended March 31, 2026
excerpt: For Q1 2026 Nebius reported USD 399.0 million revenue, USD 129.5 million adjusted EBITDA, USD 9.2982 billion cash, USD 8.4504 billion current and non-current debt, USD 2.4729 billion capital expenditure, and 308,971,701 diluted weighted-average ordinary shares.
summary: The current SEC-filed quarterly financial statements and operating review provide revenue, segment economics, operating loss, cash flow, capex, liquidity, debt, deferred revenue, share count, dilution, and customer-advance evidence for the assessment.
